newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks soft in early trade, focus on Fuji TV.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks soft in early trade, focus on Fuji TV.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were soft in early Friday morning trade, carrying on glum sentiment from Thursday deepened by weakness on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
But they said most of the market was preoccuped with the debut of shares in Fuji Television Network Inc.
Data showing Japan's current account surplus up 55.8 percent in June from a year earlier was within expectations and did not provide much direction for the market.
After 34 minutes of trade, the Nikkei 225 was down 155.82 points or 0.80 percent at 19,320.03. Nikkei September futures were down 30 at 19,340.
"There are numerous things on the agenda such as machinery order forecasts in addition to the Fuji TV listing," a trader said. "Investors may be too preoccupied to trade actively."
